Black marketeers are part salesman, part fence, and all business. Knowing a marketeer can ensure that an individual is able to move an incredibly rare and valuable item without difficulty, although it will be necessary to cut the marketeer in on the sale, which eats into profits a bit. Most consider the convenience a welcome trade-off for a percentage.

detail.name: Twi’lek Dancer
detail.description: Dance is a highly valued form of entertainment through­ out the galaxy and there are few traditions that are more famous than the Twi’lek dancing girls of Ryloth. The sen­sual beauty of a Twi’lek is something that few who have witnessed it ever forget, and it is the popularity of their skills that has contributed, at least in part, to the tradi­tion of slavery that is so rampant on Ryloth Not only are there countless parties eager to make a profit by captur­ing and selling young Twi’leks, but unfortunately, there are many influential members of the race who are con­tent to line their own pockets by doing the same thing. Among those who enter the life of a dancer, however, there are some who find that they enjoy it Those who do are typically able to make a good living entertaining the masses, although there are always those who find themselves in servitude to horrible masters like Jabba the Hutt, who is known to favor such dancers in his wretched court on the planet of Tatooine.

detail.name: Vodran Enforcer
detail.description: The reptilian Vodrans are hardy and, by and large, slavishly devoted to their Hutt masters. While some resist the rule of the Hutts, most Vodrans are content to serve the overlords they view as divine.

detail.name: Wookiee Gladiator
detail.description: The Wookiees are a noble and honorable race with a proud warrior tradition. Unfortunately for them, they are also fiercely independent and greatly val­ue individuality and personal liberties. This is obvi­ously a problem for the Empire and it is likely for that reason that the Imperial bureaucracy autho­rized the Wookiees as a slave race, making it le­gal for certain agencies to enslave them. The race’s home planet of Kashyyyk is something of a prison now and any Wookiee who attempts to leave the planet risks never being able to return. Because of their physical prowess as warriors, many enslaved Wookiees have found their way into the criminal underworld where they are pitted against other warriors in gladiatorial blood matches and various other illegal combat situations. Wookiees in this sit­uation tend to have succumbed to despair and lost themselves in their anger and bitterness. They are terrifying opponents to face in combat, but if one can gain their trust, they also prove eter nal allies.

detail.name: Scout Trooper Speeder Bike Pilot
detail.description: These scout troopers are trained in the operation of light planetary vehicles, such as speeder bikes and AT-STs. These vehicles are normally used to fly patrol routes through the jungles of Onderon.

detail.name: Lieutenant Sarev
detail.description: Lieutenant Sarev is a pinch-faced human male in his early middle years. He is twitchy and so skinny that his uniform hangs on his body, making him look younger than his actual age. He does not handle crises very well.

detail.name: Adversary
detail.description: Upgrade the difficulty of any combat check targeting this character once per rank of Adversary.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.132

detail.name: Anatomy Lessons
detail.description: After making a successful attack, may spend 1 Destiny Point to add damage equal to Intellect to one hit.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.132

detail.name: All-Terrain Driver
detail.description: Do not suffer usual penalties for driving through different terrain when using Piloting (Planetary).
detail.source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook p.142

detail.name: Armor Master
detail.description: When wearing armor, increase total soak value by 1.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.132

detail.name: Armor Master (Improved)
detail.description: When wearing armor with a soak value of 2 or higher, increase defense by 1.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.132

detail.name: Bacta Specialist
detail.description: Patients recover 1 additional wound per rank of Bacta Specialist when they recover wounds from bacta tanks or long term care.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.132

detail.name: Bad Motivator
detail.description: Once per game session, may take a Bad Motivator action; make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Mechanics check[b] to cause one targeted device to spontaneously fail.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.132

detail.name: Balance
detail.description: When the character heals strain at the end of the encounter, he may add [FO] per Force Rating. He recovers additional strain equal to [LI] generated.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.132

detail.name: Barrage
detail.description: Add 1 damage per rank of Barrage to 1 hit of successful attack while using Ranged (Heavy) or Gunnery skills at long or extreme range.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.132

detail.name: Basic Combat Training
detail.description: Brawl and Ranged (Light) become career skills.
detail.source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook p.143

detail.name: Black Market Contacts
detail.description: When purchasing illegal goods, may reduce rarity by 1 per rank of Black Market Contacts, increasing cost by 50 percent of base cost per reduction.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.132

detail.name: Blooded
detail.description: Add [BO] per rank of Blooded to all checks to resist or recover from poisons, venoms, or toxins. Reduce duration of ongoing poisons by 1 round per rank of Blooded to a minimum of 1.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.132

detail.name: Blooded (Improved)
detail.description: As an action, make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Resilience check[b] to immediately recover from all poisons and side-effects of drugs. Reduce difficulty once per rank of Blooded.

detail.name: Body Guard
detail.description: Once per round, perform the Body Guard maneuver to guard an engaged character. Suffer a number of strain no greater than ranks of Body Guard, then until the beginning of the next turn upgrade the difficulty of combat checks targeting the character by that number.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.132

detail.name: Bought Info
detail.description: Instead of making a Knowledge check, may take a Bought Info action; spend credits equal to 50 times the difficulty of the check to pass with one [SU].
detail.source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook p.143

detail.name: Brace
detail.description: Perform the Brace maneuver to remove [SE] per rank of Brace from next Action. This may only remove [SE] added by environmental circumstances.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.132

detail.name: Brace (Improved)
detail.description:
[H4]Brace (Improved)[h4]
When the character performs the Brace maneuver,
they may choose one environmental circumstance.
The benefits of Brace apply to that circumstance until
the end of the encounter. (This benefit is not cumulative with
further uses of the Brace maneuver, although
the character may select additional circumstances
with subsequent uses.)

detail.name: Brace (Supreme)
detail.description:
[H4]Brace (Supreme)[h4]
When the character performs the Brace maneuver, the benefits apply to all allies within short range.

detail.name: Brilliant Evasion
detail.description: Once per encounter may take Brilliant Evasion action. Select 1 opponent and make Opposed Piloting (Planetary or Space) check to stop opponent from attacking character for rounds equal to Agility.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.132

detail.name: Bypass Security
detail.description: Remove [SE] per rank of Bypass Security from checks made to disable a security device or open a locked door.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.133

detail.name: Careful Planning
detail.description: Once per session, may introduce a "fact" into the narrative as if a Destiny Point had been spent.
detail.source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook p.144

detail.name: Clever Solution
detail.description: Once per session, make one skill check using Cunning rather than the characteristic linked to that skill.
detail.source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook p.144

detail.name: Codebreaker
detail.description: Remove [SE] per rank in Codebreaker from checks to break codes or decrypt communications. Decrease difficulty of checks to break codes or decrypt communications by 1.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.133

detail.name: Command
detail.description: Add [BO] per rank of Command when making Leadership checks. Affected targets add [BO] to Discipline checks for next 24 hours.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.133

detail.name: Commanding Presence
detail.description: Remove [SE] per rank of Commanding Presence from Leadership and Cool checks.
detail.source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook p.144

detail.name: Confidence
detail.description: May decrease difficulty of Discipline checks to avoid fear by 1 per rank of Confidence.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.133

detail.name: Contraption
detail.description: Once per session, take Contraption action; make a [B] Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Mechanics check[b] to fashion a device to solve a current problem using just the tools and parts on hand.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.133

detail.name: Convincing Demeanor
detail.description: Remove [SE] per rank of Convincing Demeanor from any Deception or Skulduggery checks.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.133

detail.name: Coordinated Assault
detail.description: Take the Coordinated Assault maneuver; a number of engaged allies equal to Leadership ranks add [AD] to combat checks until beginning of the next turn. Range increases per rank of Coordinated Assault.
detail.source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook p.145

detail.name: Creative Killer
detail.description: Reduce the crit rating of improvised weapons by 2 (to a minimum of 1).
detail.source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook p.145

detail.name: Crippling Blow
detail.description: Increase the difficulty of next combat check by 1. If check deals damage, target suffers 1 strain whenever he moves for the remainder of the encounter.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.133

detail.name: Dead to Rights
detail.description: Spend 1 Destiny Point to add additional damage equal to half Agility (rounded up) to one hit of successful attack made with ship or vehicle-mounted weaponry.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.134

detail.name: Dead to Rights (Improved)
detail.description: Spend 1 Destiny Point to add additional damage equal to Agility (rounded up) to one hit of successful attack made with ship or vehicle-mounted weaponry.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.134

detail.name: Deadly Accuracy
detail.description: When acquired, choose 1 combat skill. Add damage equal to ranks in that skill to one hit of successful attack made using that skill.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.134

detail.name: Debilitating Shot
detail.description: Upon successful attack with a starship or vehicle weapon, may spend [AD][AD] to reduce the maximum speed of the target by 1 until the end of the next round.
detail.source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook p.145

detail.name: Dedication
detail.description: Gain +1 to a single characteristic. This cannot bring a characteristic above 6.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.134

detail.name: Defensive Driving
detail.description: Increase defense of vehicle or starship being piloted by 1 per rank of Defensive Driving.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.134

detail.name: Defensive Slicing
detail.description: When defending computer systems, add [SE] per rank of Defensive Slicing to opponent's checks.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.134

detail.name: Defensive Slicing (Improved)
detail.description: Defensive Slicing now upgrades opponents' difficulty once per rank of Defensive Slicing, this replaces the usual benefits.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.134

detail.name: Defensive Stance
detail.description: Once per round, may perform Defensive Stance maneuver and suffer a number of strain to upgrade difficulty of all incoming melee attacks by an equal number. Strain suffered this way cannot exceed ranks in Defensive Stance.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.134

detail.name: Disorient
detail.description: After hitting with combat check, may spend [AD][AD] to disorient target for number of rounds equal to ranks in Disorient.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.135

detail.name: Dodge
detail.description: When targeted by combat check, may perform a Dodge incidental to suffer a number of strain no greater than ranks of Dodge, then upgrade the difficulty of the check by that number.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.135

detail.name: Durable
detail.description: May reduce any Critical Injury suffered by 10 per rank of Durable to a minimum of 1.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.135

detail.name: Dynamic Fire
detail.description: When making a ranged attack while engaged with an opponent, may suffer 2 strain to reduce the ranged modifier by 1.
detail.source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook p.146

detail.name: Enduring
detail.description: Gain +1 soak value.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.135

detail.name: Exhaust Port
detail.description: Before attacking a starship or vehicle, the character may spend 1 Destiny Point to ignore the effects of the Massive rule for the attack.
detail.source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook p.146

detail.name: Expert Tracker
detail.description: Remove [SE] per rank of Expert Tracker from checks to find tracks or track targets. Decrease time to track a target by half.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.135

detail.name: Familiar Suns
detail.description: Once per session, may perform a Familiar Suns maneuver; make a [B] Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Knowledge (Outer Rim)[b] or [B](Core Worlds) check[b] to reveal the current type of planetary environment and other useful information.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.135

detail.name: Feral Strength
detail.description: Add 1 damage per rank of Feral Strength to one hit of successful attacks made using Brawl or Melee skills.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.135

detail.name: Field Commander
detail.description: Take the Field Commander action; make a [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Leadership check[b]. A number of allies equal to Presence may immediately suffer 1 strain to perform 1 free maneuver.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.135

detail.name: Field Commander (Improved)
detail.description: Field Commander action affects allies equal to double Presence, and may spend [TR] to allow allies to suffer 1 strain and perform 1 free action instead.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.135

detail.name: Fine Tuning
detail.description: When reducing the amount of system strain a starship or vehicle suffers, reduce 1 additional strain per rank of Fine Tuning.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.135

detail.name: Fire Control
detail.description: Take the Fire Control action; all combat checks made from current starship or vehicle count their target's silhouette as one higher than normal until the beginning of next turn. Does not stack.
detail.source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook p.147

detail.name: Forager
detail.description: Remove up to [SE][SE] from skill checks to find food, water, or shelter. Survival checks to forage take half the time.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.135

detail.name: Force of Will
detail.description: Once per session, make one skill check using Willpower rather than the characteristic linked to that skill.
detail.source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook p.147

detail.name: Force Rating
detail.description: Gain +1 Force Rating.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.135

detail.name: Form On Me
detail.description: Allies equal to ranks in Leadership in close range gain the benefits of the Gain the Advantage action.
detail.source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook p.147

detail.name: Frenzied Attack
detail.description: When making a Melee or Brawl check, suffer a number of strain to upgrade the attack an equal number of times. The strain suffered may not exceed ranks in Frenzied Attack.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.135

detail.name: Full Stop
detail.description: When piloting a ship or vehicle, take a full-stop maneuver to reduce speed to zero and suffer system strain equal to the speed reduced.
detail.source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook p.147

detail.name: Full Throttle
detail.description: Take a Full Throttle action; make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Piloting check[b] to increase a vehicle's top speed by 1 for a number of rounds equal to Cunning.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.135

detail.name: Full Throttle (Improved)
detail.description: Suffer 1 strain to attempt Full Throttle as a maneuver and decrease its difficultly to [B]Average ([DI][DI])[b].
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.136

detail.name: Full Throttle (Supreme)
detail.description: When performing Full Throttle, top speed increases by 2 instead of 1.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.136

detail.name: Galaxy Mapper
detail.description: Remove [SE] per rank of Galaxy Mapper from Astrogation checks. Astrogation checks take half normal time.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.136

detail.name: Gearhead
detail.description: Remove [SE] per rank of Gearhead from Mechanics checks. Have the credit cost to add mods to attachments.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.136

detail.name: Greased Palms
detail.description: Before making a social check, may spend up to 50 credits per rank of Greased Palms to upgrade the ability of the check once for every 50 spent.
detail.source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook p.148

detail.name: Grit
detail.description: Gain +1 strain threshold
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.136

detail.name: Hard Headed
detail.description: When staggered or disoriented, perform the Hard Headed action; make a [B]Daunting ([DI][DI][DI][DI]) Discipline check[b] to remove status. Difficulty reduced per rank of Hard Headed.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.136

detail.name: Hard Headed (Improved)
detail.description: When incapacitated due to strain exceeding threshold, may take a more difficult. Hard Headed action to reduce strain to 1 below threshold.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.136

detail.name: Heightened Awareness
detail.description: Allies within close range add [BO] to Perception or Vigilance checks. Engaged allies add [BO][BO].
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.136

detail.name: Heroic Fortitude
detail.description: May spend 1 Destiny Point to ignore effects of Critical Injuries on Brawn or Agility checks until the end of the encounter.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.137

detail.name: Hidden Storage
detail.description: Gain hidden storage in vehicles or equipment that holds items with total encumbrance equal to ranks in Hidden Storage.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.137

detail.name: Hold Together
detail.description: Spend 1 Destiny Point to perform a Hold Together incidental immediately after vehicle or starship takes damage to turn it into system strain.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.137

detail.name: Hunter
detail.description: Add [BO] per rank of Hunter to all checks when interacting with beast or animals (including combat checks). Add +10 to Critical Injury results against beasts or animals per rank of Hunter.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.137

detail.name: Incite Rebellion
detail.description: Once per session, may take an Incite Rebellion action; make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Coercion check[b] to cause a number of beings up to ranks in Coercion to become rebellious until the end of the encounter.
detail.source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook p.149

detail.name: Indistinguishable
detail.description: Upgrade difficulty of checks to identify character once per rank of Indistinguishable.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.137

detail.name: Insight
detail.description: Perception and Discipline become career skills.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.137

detail.name: Inspiring Rhetoric
detail.description: Take the Inspiring Rhetoric action; making an [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Leadership check[b]. Each [SU], 1 ally within close range recovers 1 strain. Spend [AD] to cause 1 affected ally to recover 1 additional strain.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.137

detail.name: Inspiring Rhetoric (Improved)
detail.description: Each ally affected by Inspiring Rhetoric gains [BO] on all skill checks for a number of rounds equal to ranks in Leadership.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.137

detail.name: Inspiring Rhetoric (Supreme)
detail.description: Suffer 1 strain to perform Inspiring Rhetoric as a maneuver, not an action.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.137

detail.name: Intense Focus
detail.description: Perform an Intense Focus maneuver; suffer 1 strain and upgrade the ability of the next skill check once.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.137

detail.name: Intense Presence
detail.description: Spend 1 Destiny Point to recover strain equal to Presence rating.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.137

detail.name: Intimidating
detail.description: May suffer a number of strain to downgrade difficulty of Coercion checks, or upgrade difficulty when targeted by Coercion checks, by an equal number. Strain suffered this way cannot exceed ranks in Intimidating.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.137

detail.name: Inventor
detail.description: When constructing new items or modifying existing attachments, add [BO] or remove [SE] per rank of Inventor.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.137

detail.name: Invigorate
detail.description: Once per encounter, may add [FO] to a check using Brawn or Agility made by an ally in short range [LI] add [SU] and [DA] add [TH].
detail.source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook p.150

detail.name: It's Not that Bad
detail.description: Once per session when an ally would suffer a Critical Injury, may take an It's Not That Bad action; make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Medicine check[b] to stop the ally from gaining the Critical Injury.
detail.source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook p.150

detail.name: Jump Up
detail.description: Once per round, may stand from seated or prone as an incidental.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.138

detail.name: Jury Rigged
detail.description: The character chooses one personal weapon or piece of armor per rank of Jury Rigged, They may increase the damage of the weapon by one: decrease the Advantage cost on its Critical, or any single other effect by one to a minimum of one; or increase armor's ranged or melee defense by one. Alternatively, they can decrease the encumbrance of the item by two to a minimum of one. The bonus only applies so long as the character is using the item. If the item is ever lost or destroyed, the character may apply Jury Rigged to a new personal weapon or piece or armor.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.138

detail.name: Kill With Kindness
detail.description: Remove [SE] per rank of Kill with Kindness from all Charm and Leadership checks.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.138

detail.name: Knockdown
detail.description: After hitting with a melee attack, may spend [TR] to knock the target prone.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.138

detail.name: Know Somebody
detail.description: Once per session, when attempting to purchase a legally available item, reduce its rarity by 1 per rank of Know Somebody.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.138

detail.name: Knowledge Specialization
detail.description: When acquired, choose 1 Knowledge skill. When making that skill check, may spend [TR] result to gain additional successes equal to ranks in Knowledge Specialization.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.138

detail.name: Known Schematic
detail.description: Once per session, may perform the Known Schematic maneuver; make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Knowledge (Education) check[b]. Success grants familiarity with a building or ship's design.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.138

detail.name: Let's Ride
detail.description: Once per round, may mount or dismount a vehicle or beast, or enter a cockpit or weapon station on a vehicle, as an incidental.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.138

detail.name: Lethal Blows
detail.description: Add +10 per rank of Lethal Blows to any Critical Injury results inflicted on opponents.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.138

detail.name: Master Doctor
detail.description: Once per round, suffer 2 strain to decrease the difficulty of a Medicine check by 1.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.138

detail.name: Master Driver
detail.description: Once per round when driving a vehicle, may suffer 2 strain to perform any action as a maneuver.
detail.source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook p.151

detail.name: Master Grenadier
detail.description: Decrease the [AD] cost to activate the Blast quality on any weapon used by 1 to a minimum of 1.
detail.source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook p.151

detail.name: Master Leader
detail.description: Once per round, suffer 2 strain to decrease difficulty of the next Leadership check by one, to a minimum of [B]Easy ([DI]).[b]
detail.source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook p.151

detail.name: Master Merchant
detail.description: When buying or selling goods, or paying off or taking Obligation, may suffer 2 strain to sell for 25% more, but for 25% less, pay off 1 more Obligation, or take 1 less.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.138

detail.name: Master of Shadows
detail.description: Once per round, suffer 2 strain to decrease difficulty of next Stealth or Skulduggery check by one.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.138

detail.name: Master Pilot
detail.description: Once per round when piloting a starship, may suffer 2 strain to perform any action as a maneuver.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.138

detail.name: Master Slicer
detail.description: Once per round, may take a Master Sliver incidental to suffer 2 strain and decrease difficulty of Computers or other slicing checks by 1 to a minimum of [B]Easy ([DI])[b].
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.139

detail.name: Master Starhopper
detail.description: Once per round, suffer 2 strain to decrease the difficulty of next Astrogation check by 1 to a minimum of [B]Easy ([DI])[b].
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.139

detail.name: Mental Fortress
detail.description: Spend 1 Destiny Point to ignore effects of Critical Injuries on Intellect or Cunning checks until end of encounter.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.139

detail.name: Natural Brawler
detail.description: Once per session, may reroll any 1 Brawl or Melee check.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.139

detail.name: Natural Charmer
detail.description: Once per session, may reroll 1 Charm or Deception check.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.139

detail.name: Natural Doctor
detail.description: Once per session, may reroll any 1 Medicine check.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.139

detail.name: Natural Driver
detail.description: Once per session, may reroll any 1 Piloting (Planetary) or Gunnery check.
detail.source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook p.153

detail.name: Natural Enforcer
detail.description: Once per session, may reroll any 1 Coercion or Streetwise check.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.139

detail.name: Natural Hunter
detail.description: Once per session, may reroll any 1 Perception or Vigilance check.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.139

detail.name: Natural Leader
detail.description: Once per session, may reroll any 1 Cool or Leadership check.
detail.source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook p.153

detail.name: Natural Marksman
detail.description: Once per session, may reroll any 1 Ranged (Light) or Ranged (Heavy) check.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.139

detail.name: Natural Negotiator
detail.description: Once per session, may reroll any 1 Cool or Negotiation check.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.139

detail.name: Natural Outdoorsman
detail.description: Once per session, may reroll any 1 Resilience or Survival check.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.139

detail.name: Natural Pilot
detail.description: Once per session, may reroll any Piloting (Space) or Gunnery check.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.139

detail.name: Natural Programmer
detail.description: Once per session, may reroll any 1 Computers or Astrogation check.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.139

detail.name: Natural Rogue
detail.description: Once per session, may reroll any 1 Skulduggery or Stealth check.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.139

detail.name: Natural Scholar
detail.description: Once per session, may reroll any 1 Knowledge skill check.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.139

detail.name: Natural Tinkerer
detail.description: Once per session, may reroll any 1 Mechanics check.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.139

detail.name: Nobody's Fool
detail.description: May upgrade difficulty of incoming Charm, Coercion, or Deception checks once per rank of Nobody's Fool.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.139

detail.name: Outdoorsman
detail.description: Remove [SE] per rank of Outdoorsman from checks to move through terrain or manage environmental effects. Decrease overland travel times by half.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.141

detail.name: Overwhelm Emotions
detail.description: May add [FO] per Force Rating to Charm, Coercion, or Deception checks. [LI] and [DA] add [SU] to some checks and [FA] to others.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.141

detail.name: Overwhelm Defenses
detail.description: Upon unsuccessful attack with a starship or vehicle weapon, may spend [AD][AD] per rank of Overwhelm Defenses. Reduce the defense in the targeted zone by 1 for every [AD][AD] spent.
detail.source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook p.154

detail.name: Physical Training
detail.description: Add [BO] per rank of Physical Training to Athletics and Resilience checks.
detail.source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook p.154

detail.name: Plausible Deniability
detail.description: Remove [SE] per rank of Plausible Deniability from all Coercion and Deception checks.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.141

detail.name: Point Blank
detail.description: Add 1 damage per rank of Point Blank to damage of one hit of successful attack while using Ranged (Heavy) or Ranged (Light) skills at short range or engaged.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.141

detail.name: Powerful Blast
detail.description: Increase Blast damage dealt by explosives, explosive weapons, and grenafes by +1 per rank of Powerful Blast.
detail.source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook p.154

detail.name: Precise Aim
detail.description: Once per round, may perform Precise Aim maneuver. Suffer a number of strain no greater than ranks in Precise Aim, then reduce target's melee and ranged defense by that number.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.141

detail.name: Pressure Point
detail.description: When making a Brawl check against an opponent, instead of dealing damage, may deal equivalent strain plus additional strain equal to ranks of Medicine (this ignores soak).
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.141

detail.name: Quick Draw
detail.description: Once per round, draw or holster a weapon or accessible item as an incidental.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.141

detail.name: Quick Fix
detail.description: Once per session, make one skill check using Agility rather than the characterstic linked to that skill.
detail.source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook p.154

detail.name: Quick Strike
detail.description: Add [BO] per rank of Quick Strike to combat checks against targets that have not acted yet this encounter.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.141

detail.name: Rapid Reaction
detail.description: Suffer a number of strain to add an equal number of [SU] to initiative checks. Strain suffered cannot exceed ranks in Rapid Reaction.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.141

detail.name: Rapid Recovery
detail.description: When healing strain after an encounter, heal 1 additional strain per rank of Rapid Recovery.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.141

detail.name: Redundant Systems
detail.description: Once per session, may take a Redundant Systems action; make an [B]Easy ([DI]) Mechanics check[b] to harvest components from a functioning device to repair a broken one without breaking the first device.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.141

detail.name: Researcher
detail.description: Remove [SE] per rank of Researcher from all Knowledge checks. Reserching a subject takes half the time.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.141

detail.name: Resolve
detail.description: When a character involuntarily suffers strain, he suffers 1 less strain per tank of Resolve to a minimum of 1.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.142

detail.name: Respected Scholar
detail.description: May downgrade difficulty of checks to interact with institutes of learning by one level per rank of Respected Scholar.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.142

detail.name: Scathing Tirade
detail.description: Take a Scathing Tirade action; make an [B] Average ([DI][DI]) Coercion check[b]. Each [SU] causes one enemy in short range to suffer 1 strain. Spend [AD] to cause 1 affected enemy to suffer 1 additional strain.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.142

detail.name: Scathing Tirade (Improved)
detail.description: Each enemy affected by Scathing Tirade suffers [SE] on all skill checks for a number of rounds equal to ranks in Coercion.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.142

detail.name: Scathing Tirade (Supreme)
detail.description: Suffer 1 strain to perform Scathing Tirade as a maneuver, not an action.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.142

detail.name: Second Wind
detail.description: Once per encounter, may use Second Wind incidental to heal strain equal to ranks in Second Wind.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.142

detail.name: Selective Detonation
detail.description: When using a weapon with the Blast quality spend [AD] to exclude 1 target that would be affected by the explosion, up to ranks in Selective Detonation.
detail.source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook p.155

detail.name: Sense Danger
detail.description: Once per session, remove [SE][SE] from any 1 check.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.142

detail.name: Sense Emotions
detail.description: Add [BO] to all Charm, Coercion, and Deception checks unless the target is immune to Force powers.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.142

detail.name: Shortcut
detail.description: During a chase; add [BO] per rank in Shortcut to any checks made to catch or escape an opponent.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.142

detail.name: Side Step
detail.description: Once per round, may perform Side Step maneuver and suffer a number of strain to upgrade difficulty of all incoming ranged attacks by an equal number for the next round. Strain suffered this way cannot exceed ranks in Side Step.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.142

detail.name: Situational Awareness
detail.description: Allies with short range of the vehicle add [BO] to their Perception and Vigilance checks. Allies within close range add [BO][BO] instead.
detail.source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook p.156

detail.name: Sixth Sense
detail.description: Gain +1 ranged defense.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.142

detail.name: Skilled Jockey
detail.description: Remove [SE] per rank of Skilled Jockey from all Piloting (Planetary) and Piloting (Space) checks the character attempts.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.142

detail.name: Skilled Slicer
detail.description: When making a Computers check may spend [TR] to make further Computers checks within this system as maneuvers.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.142

detail.name: Sleight of Mind
detail.description: Add [BO] to all Stealth checks unless the opposition is immune to Force powers.
detail.source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook p.156

detail.name: Smooth Talker
detail.description: When first acquired choose 1 skill; Charm, Coercion, Deception, or Negotiation. When making checks with that skill spend [TR] to gain additional [SU] equal to ranks in Smooth Talker.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.142

detail.name: Sniper Shot
detail.description: Before making a non-thrown ranged attack, may perform a Sniper Shot maneuver to increase the weapon's range by 1 range band per rank in Sniper Shot. Upgrade the difficulty of the attack by 1 per range band increase.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.142

detail.name: Soft Spot
detail.description: After making a successful attack, may spend 1 Destiny Point to add damage equal to Cunning to one hit.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.143

detail.name: Solid Repairs
detail.description: The character repairs +1 hull trauma per rank of Solid Repairs whenever he repairs a starship or vehicle.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.143

detail.name: Sound Investments
detail.description: At the start of each session, gain 100 credits for each rank of Sound Investments.
detail.source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook p.156

detail.name: Spare Clip
detail.description: Cannot run out of ammo due to [DE]. Items with Limited Ammo quality run out of ammo as normal.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.143

detail.name: Speaks Binary
detail.description: When directing NPC droids, may grant them [BO] per rank of Speaks Binary on checks.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.143

detail.name: Stalker
detail.description: Add [BO] per rank of Stalker to all Stealth and Coordination checks.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.143

detail.name: Steely Nerves
detail.description: Spend 1 Destiny Point to ignore effects of Critical Injuries on Willpower or Presence checks until the end of the encounter.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.143

detail.name: Stim Application
detail.description: Take the Stim Application Action; make an [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Medicine check[b]. If successful 1 engaged ally increases 1 characteristic by 1 for the remained of the encounter and suffers 4 strain.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.143

detail.name: Stim Application (Improved)
detail.description: When performing Stim Application Action, may increase difficulty of check to [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI])[b], and target only suffers 1 strain.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.143

detail.name: Stim Application (Supreme)
detail.description: When performing ther Stim Application Action, spend [TR] to increase an additional Characteristic by 1.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.143

detail.name: Stimpack Specialization
detail.description: Stimpacks heal 1 additional wound per rank of Stimpack Specialization.
detail.source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook p.157

detail.name: Street Smarts
detail.description: Remove [SE] per rank of Street Smarts from Streetwise or Knowledge (Underworld) checks.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.144

detail.name: Stroke of Genius
detail.description: Once per session, make one skill check using Intellect rather than the characteristic linked to that skill.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.144

detail.name: Strong Arm
detail.description: Treat thrown weapons as if they had 1 greater range.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.144

detail.name: Stunning Blow
detail.description: While making Melee checks, may inflict damage as strain instead of wounds. This does not ignore soak.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.144

detail.name: Stunning Blow (Improved)
detail.description: When dealing strain damage with Melee or Brawl checks, may spend [TR] to stagger target for 1 round per [TR]
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.144

detail.name: Superior Reflexes
detail.description: Gain +1 melee damage.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.144

detail.name: Surgeon
detail.description: When making a Medicine check to help a character heal wounds, the target heals 1 additional wound per rank of Surgeon.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.144

detail.name: Swift
detail.description: Do not suffer usual penalties for moving through difficult terrain.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.144

detail.name: Tactical Combat Training
detail.description: Melee and Ranged (Heavy) become career skills.
detail.source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook p.158

detail.name: Targeted Blow
detail.description: After making a successful attack, may spend 1 Destiny Point to add damage equal to Agility to one hit.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.144

detail.name: Technical Aptitude
detail.description: Reduces time needed to complete Computer-related tasks by 25% per rank.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.145

detail.name: Time to Go
detail.description: The character may spend 1 Destiny Point to perform a Move maneuver as an incidental to attempt to move into cover or out of the blast range of a weapon or explosion.
detail.source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook p.158

detail.name: Time to Go (Improved)
detail.description: When activating Time to Go, allow 1 engaged ally to also perform an out of turn Move maneuver as an incidental to attempt to move into cover or out of the blast range of a weapon or explosion.
detail.source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook p.158

detail.name: Tinkerer
detail.description: May add 1 additional hard point to a number of items equal to ranks in Tinkerer. Each item may only be modified once.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.145

detail.name: Touch of Fate
detail.description: Once per session, add [BO][BO] to any 1 check.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.145

detail.name: Toughened
detail.description: Gain +2 wound threshold.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.145

detail.name: Tricky Target
detail.description: Count vehicle or starship piloted as having a silhouette 1 lower when being attacked.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.145

detail.name: True Aim
detail.description: Once per round, may perform a True Aim maneuver to gain benefits of aiming and upgrade combat check once per rank of True Aim.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.145

detail.name: Uncanny Reactions
detail.description: Add [BO] per rank of Uncanny Reactions to all Vigilance checks.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.145

detail.name: Uncanny Senses
detail.description: Add [BO] per rank of Uncanny Senses to all Perception checks.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.145

detail.name: Unstoppable
detail.description: If a Critical Injury roll is 1 or reduced to 1, do not receive the critical injury.
detail.source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook p.159

detail.name: Utility Belt
detail.description: Spend 1 Destiny Point to perform a Utility Belt incidental; produce a previously undocumented item or weapon (with restrictions) from a tool belt or a satchel.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.145

detail.name: Utinni!
detail.description: Remove [SE] per rank of Utinni! from checks to find or scavenge items or gear. Such checks take half the time.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.145

detail.name: Vehicle Combat Training
detail.description: Gunnery and Piloting (Planetary) become career skills.
detail.source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook p.159

detail.name: Well Rounded
detail.description: Choose any 2 skills. They permanently become career skills.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.145

detail.name: Well Traveled
detail.description: Knowledge (Core Worlds) and Knowledge (Outer Rim) become career skills.
detail.source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook p.159

detail.name: Wheel and Deal
detail.description: When selling good legally, gain 10% more credits per rank of Wheel and Deal.
detail.source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.145

detail.name: Works Like A Charm
detail.description: Once per session, make one skill check using Presence rather than the characteristic linked to that skill.
detail.source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook p.159

detail.name: Pin
detail.description: Take Pin action; make an [B]Opposed athletics check[b] to immobilize an engaged opponent until the end of the character's next turn. Spend [TR] to extend duration one round.

detail.name: Museum Worthy
detail.description: Once per session, take Museum Worthy action, make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Knowledge (Education) check[b] to ascetain information regarding a relic, ruin, or piece of history.

detail.name: Bring It Down
detail.description: Once per attack, spend 1 Destiny Point to add damage to a single hit equal to target's Brawn value.

detail.name: Hunter's Quarry
detail.description: Take Hunter's Quarry action, make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Survival check[b] to upgrade the ability of all attacks made against a target at long range until the end of the character's next turn.

detail.name: Hunter's Quarry (Improved)
detail.description: Suffer 2 strain to perform Hunter's Quarry action as a maneuver.

detail.name: Burly
detail.description: Reduce any weilded weapon's Cumbersome quality and Encumberance rating by a nyumber equal to ranks in Burly to a minimum of 1.

detail.name: Fearsome
detail.description: When an adversary becomes engaged with the character, the character may force the adversary to make a fear check, with the difficulty equal to the character's ranks in Fearsome.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.142

detail.name: Heavy Hitter
detail.description: Once per session, spend [TR] on a successful Ranged (Heavy) or Gunnery check to add the Breach 1 quality to the attack, or increase an existing Breach rating by 1.

detail.name: Heroic Resilience
detail.description: Immediately after being hit by an attack but before suffering damage, spend 1 Destiny Point to increase soak by ranks in Resiliance.

detail.name: Improvised Detonation
detail.description: Once per session, make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Mechanics check[b] to perform the Improvised Detonation action and build an explosive device, dealing damage equal to ranks in Intellect + ranks in Mechanics + [SU].

detail.name: Improvised Detonation (Improved)
detail.description: Reduce the difficulty of Improvis Detonation to [B]Average ([DI][DI]) and increase damage to twice ranks in Mechanics.

detail.name: Loom
detail.description: When an ally engaged with the character makes a successful Charm, Deception, or Negotiation check, the character adds [AD] per rank in Coercion to the ally's check.

detail.name: Rain of Death
detail.description: Perform the Rain of Death maneuver to ignore the increased difficulty due to the Auto-fire quality of attacks made this turn.

detail.name: Steady Nerves
detail.description: Remove [SE] per rank of Steady Nerves from Cool or Skulduggery checks.

detail.name: Talk the Talk
detail.description: When making a Knowledge skill check, the character may spend 1 Destiny Point to substitute Knowledge (Underworld) or Streetwise for the required skill.

detail.name: Walk the Walk
detail.description: The character may spend 1 Destiny Point to add damage equal to his ranks in Streetwise to one hit of a successful Brawl check.

detail.name: Idealist
detail.description: Spend 1 stain to add an [AD] on a skill check.

detail.name: Against All Odds
detail.description: When incapacitated, perform Against All Odds action, making [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Resilience check[b] with [FO] equal to Force rating. Heal wounds equal to [SU], spend [FP] to add [SU].
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.138

detail.name: Animal Bond
detail.description: Develop long-term bond with single animal of silhouette no greater than half Force rating rounded down.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.138

detail.name: Animal Bond (Improved)
detail.description: When spending a maneuver to direct a bonded animal, the character may suffer 1 strain to add [BO] to the animals next check.

detail.name: Animal Empathy
detail.description: When making checks to handle or tame animals, add [FO] no greater than Force rating to the check. Spend [FP] to add [SU] or [AD] to the check.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.139

detail.name: Ataru Technique
detail.description: When making a check using the Lightsaber skill, the character may use Agility instead of Brawn.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.139

detail.name: Body Guard (Improved)
detail.description: Once per session, when an ally protected by the Body Guard maneuver suffers a hit, suffer the hit instead.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.140

detail.name: Body Guard (Supreme)
detail.description: Body Guard maneuver may protect a number of engaged characters up to ranks in Reilience.

detail.name: Calming Aura
detail.description: When an opponent targets character with a Force power, reduce [FP] generated by 1.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.140

detail.name: Calming Aura (Improved)
detail.description: Spend a maneuver and suffer 2 strain to extend Calming Aura's effects to allies equal to Willpower at short range until start of next turn.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.140

detail.name: Center of Being
detail.description: Take a Center of Being maneuver. Until the beginning of next turn, attacks against the character increase their critical rating by 1 per rank of Center of Being.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.140

detail.name: Center of Being (Improved)
detail.description: Suffer 1 strain to perform Center of Being maneuver as an incidental.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.140

detail.name: Circle of Shelter
detail.description: When an engaged ally suffers a hit, may use Parry or Reflect incidental against the hit.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.140

detail.name: Comprehend Technology
detail.description: Take Comprehend Technology action; make an [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Knowledge (Education) check[b] to use Force rating as ranks in skills to use a single item.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.141

detail.name: Conditioned
detail.description: Remove [SE] per rank of Conditioned from Athletics and Coordination check. Reduce the damage and strain suffered from falling by 1 per rank of Conditioned.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.141

detail.name: Contingency Plan
detail.description: Spend 1 Destiny Point to recover strain equal to Cunning rating.

detail.name: Counterstrike
detail.description: When an attack misses the character and generates [DE] or [TH][TH], may upgrade next Lightsaber (Cunning) check against attacker during encounter once.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.141

detail.name: Defensive Circle
detail.description: May take the Defensive Circle action, making a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Lightsaber (Intellect) check[b]. The character, plus one ally within short range per [SU], gains X defense until the beginning of next turn. X equals 1, plus 1 per [AD][AD].
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.141

detail.name: Defensive Training
detail.description: When wielding a Lightsaber, Melee, or Brawl weapon, the weapon gains the Defensive quality with a rating equal to ranks in Defensive Training.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.141

detail.name: Disruptive Strike
detail.description: Perform Disruptive Strike action; make a Lightsaber (Cunning) combat check, adding [FO] no greater than Force rating. Spend [FP] to add [FA] to the next combat check the target makes.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.142

detail.name: Djem So Deflection
detail.description: After using Reflect, may spend 1 Destiny Point to perform Move maneuver as out-of-turn incidental to close distance with or engage opponent.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.142

detail.name: Draw Closer
detail.description: Perform Draw Closer action; make a Lightsaber (Willpower) combat check against one silhouette 1 target within medium range, adding [FO] no greater than Force rating to check. Spend [FP] to move target one range band closer or to add [SU] to check.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.142

detail.name: Duelist's Training
detail.description: Add [BO] to Melee and Lightsaber checks when engaged with only one opponent.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.142

detail.name: Enhanced Leader
detail.description: When making a Leadership check, add [FO] no greater than Force rating. Spend [FP] to add [SU] or [AD] to the result.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.142

detail.name: Falling Avalanche
detail.description: Suffer 2 strain to add damage equal to Brawn to next Lightsaber combat check made that turn.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.142

detail.name: Feint
detail.description: Spend [TR] or [AD][AD][AD] generated on a missed melee attack to upgrade difficulty of opponent's next attack targeting character by ranks in Feint.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.142

detail.name: Force Assault
detail.description: Spend [TR] or [AD][AD][AD] on a missed Lightsaber (Willpower) combat check to immediately perform Move Force power action as maneuver.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.143

detail.name: Force Protection
detail.description: Perform the Force Protection maneuver; suffer 1 strain and commit [FO] up to ranks of Force Protection. Increase soak by number of [FO] committed until beginning of next turn. Suffer 1 strain every turn [FO] remains committed.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.143

detail.name: Forewarning
detail.description: Perform the Forewarning action. All allies within medium range increase defense by character's Force rating until they act in the encounter.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.143

detail.name: Hawk Bat Swoop
detail.description: Take the Hawk Bat Swoop action. Perform a Lightsaber (Agility) combat check against target within short range, adding [FO] no greater than Force rating. Spend [FP] to engage target and spend [FP] to add [AD] to check.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.144

detail.name: Healing Trance
detail.description: Commit [FO]. For every full encounter [FO] remains committed, heal 1 wound per rank of Healing Trance.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.144

detail.name: Healing Trance (Improved)
detail.description: When healing wounds due to Healing Trance, make a Resilience check to heal a Critical Injury. Difficulty of the check equals severity of the Critical Injurt.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.144

detail.name: Imbue Item
detail.description: Take the Imbue Item maneuver; suffer 1 strain and commit [FO] to grant one weapon, piece of armor, or item an improvement while [FO] remains committed. Suffer 1 strain every round [FO] remains committed.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.145

detail.name: Intuitive Evasion
detail.description: Perform the Intuitive Evasion maneuver; suffer 1 strain and commit [FO] up to ranks of Intuitive Evasion. Upgrade difficulty of combat checks targeting starship or vehicle by equal amount. Suffer 1 strain every round [FO] remains committed.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.145

detail.name: Intuitive Improvements
detail.description: When making check to craft or repair item, may add [FO] no greater than Force rating to check. Spend [FP][FP] to increase hard points by 1, to max of +2.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.145

detail.name: Intuitive Shot
detail.description: When maing a Ranged (Heavy) or Range (Light) combat check, add [FO] no greater than Force rating to the check. May spend [FP] to add [SU] or [AD].
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.145

detail.name: Intuitive Strike
detail.description: When making a combat check with a planetary scale weapon, add [FO] no greater than Force rating to the check. Spend [FP][FP] to add [SU] or [AD].
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.145

detail.name: Keen Eyed
detail.description: Remove [SE] per rank of Keen Eyed from Perception and Vigilance checks. Decrease time to search a specific area by half.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.146

detail.name: Knowledge is Power
detail.description: Once per session, when making a check count Force rating as being equal to ranks in Knowledge (Lore).
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.103

detail.name: Knowledgeable Healing
detail.description: When healing an ally, spend 1 Destiny Point to heal additional wounds equal to ranks in Knowledge (Xenology).
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.146

detail.name: Makashi Finish
detail.description: Take the Makashi Finish action; Perform a Lightsaber (Presence) combat check against engaged target, adding [FO] no greater than Force rating. Spend [FP] to add +10 to any resulting Critical Injury rolls.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.146

detail.name: Makashi Flourish
detail.description: Once per encounter, perform Makashi Flourish action. Make an [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Lightsaber (Presence) check[b]. 1 engaged opponent suffers strain equal to [SU], and heal an equal amount of strain.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.146

detail.name: Makashi Technique
detail.description: When making a check using the Lightsaber skill, the character may use Presence instead of Brawn.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.146

detail.name: Master Artisan
detail.description: Once per round, may take the Master Artisan Incidental; suffer 2 strain to decrease the difficulty of next Mechanics check by 1, to a minimum of [B]Easy ([DI])[b].
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.146

detail.name: Mental Bond
detail.description: May perform the Mental Bond action. Commit [FO]. While committed, may communicate with bonded animal at long range and see and hear through its senses.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.147

detail.name: Mental Tools
detail.description: Always count as having the right tools for the job when performing Mechanics checks.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.147

detail.name: Multiple Opponents
detail.description: Add [BO] to Lightsaber, Brawl, and Melee checks when engaged with multiple opponents.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.147

detail.name: Natural Blademaster
detail.description: Once per session, may reroll any 1 Lightsaber or Melee check.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.147

detail.name: Natural Mystic
detail.description: Once per session, may reroll any 1 Force power check.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.148

detail.name: Niman Technique
detail.description: When making a Lightsaber skill check, the character may use Willpower instead of Brawn.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.148

detail.name: Now You See Me
detail.description: Once per session, take Now You See Me action. Make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Deception check[b] to make a number of NPC's equal to Cunning within medium range forget about character.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.148

detail.name: One With The Universe
detail.description: Once per session, mediate, then perform One with the Universe action; make [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Astrogation check[b]. If successful, add [LI] to all Force power checks in next encounter. If successful with [TH], add [DA] instead.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.149

detail.name: Parry
detail.description: When hit by a melee attack, suffer 3 strain to reduce damage by 2 plus ranks in Parry.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.149

detail.name: Parry (Improved)
detail.description: When parrying a hit that generate [DE] or [TH][TH][TH], may hit attacker once with Lightsaber, Brawl, or Melee weapon (dealing base damage) after original attack resolves.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.149

detail.name: Parry (Supreme)
detail.description: If the user did not make a combat check during his previous turn, may suffer 1 strain to use Parry.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.149

detail.name: Physician
detail.description: When making a Medicine check to help a character heal wounds, the target heals 1 additional strain per rank of Physician.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.149

detail.name: Preemptive Avoidance
detail.description: May spend 1 Destiny Point to disengage from engaged enemy as an out-of-turn incidental.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.149

detail.name: Prey on the Weak
detail.description: Add +1 damage to one hit of successful combat checks against disoriented targets per rank of Prey on the Weak.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.149

detail.name: Quick Movement
detail.description: Suffer 2 strain to perform the Quick Movement incidental; add [FO] no greater than Force rating to next check. May spend [FP][FP] to perform one additional Move maneuver after action.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.150

detail.name: Reflect
detail.description: When hit by a ranged attack, suffer 3 strain to reduce damage by 2 plus ranks in Reflect.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.150

detail.name: Reflect (Improved)
detail.description: When reflecting a hit that generated [DE] or [TH][TH][TH] may hit one target in medium range with the same damage as the initial hit, after original attack resolves.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.150

detail.name: Reflect (Supreme)
detail.description: If the user did not make a combat check during previous turn, may suffer 1 strain to use Reflect.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.150

detail.name: Resist Disarm
detail.description: Suffer 2 strain to avoid being disarmed or have weapon damaged or destroyed.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.151

detail.name: Saber Swarm
detail.description: Perform the Saber Swarm maneuver; suffer 1 strain to make next Lightsaber (Agility) combat check this turn gain the Linked item quality equal to Force rating during check.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.151

detail.name: Saber Throw
detail.description: Perform Saber Throw action; make Lightsaber combat check as ranged attack at target within medium range, adding [FO] no greater than Force rating. Must spend [FP] and succeed to hit target; spend [FP] to have weapon return to hand.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.151

detail.name: Sarlacc Sweep
detail.description: Increase difficulty of Lightsaber check by 1 to perform Sarlacc Sweep action. May spend [AD][AD] to hit additional engaged targets.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.151

detail.name: Sense Advantage
detail.description: Once per session, may add [SE][SE] to 1 NPC's skill check.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.151

detail.name: Share Pain
detail.description: May perform the Share Pain incidental when bonded animal suffers wounds. Reduce wounds suffered to half, then character suffers wounds equal to number reduced.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.151

detail.name: Shien Technique
detail.description: When making a check using the Lightsaber skill, the character may use Cunning instead of Brawn.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.151

detail.name: Shroud
detail.description: The character may spend 1 Destiny Point to make himself undetectable via Force powers and make his own powers go unnoticed for the remainder of the encounter.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.151

detail.name: Slippery Minded
detail.description: If under the effects of a Force power, perform the Slippery Minded action; make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Deception check[b] to immediately end effects of power.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.152

detail.name: Soresu Technique
detail.description: When making a Lightsaber skill check, the character may use Intellect instead of Brawn.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.152

detail.name: Strategic Form
detail.description: May take the Strategic Form action, making a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Lightsaber check[b] rolling [FO] no greater than Force rating. If successful, 1 target within short range may only attack character for 1 round. Spend [FP] to extend effects for 1 target for 1 round.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.152

detail.name: Sum Djem
detail.description: May spend [TR] or [AD][AD] with a successful Lightsaber check to disarm opponent.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.152

detail.name: Terrify
detail.description: Take the Terrify action; make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Coercion check[b], adding [FO] no greater than Force rating. Disorient one target within medium range per [SU]. Spend [AD][AD] to extend duration and spend [FP] to immobilize affected target.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.153

detail.name: Terrify (Improved)
detail.description: Reduce the difficulty of Terrify's check to [B]Average ([DI][DI])[b] and may spend [TR] to stagger an affected target.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.153

detail.name: The Force Is My Ally
detail.description: Once per session, may suffer 2 strain to perform Force power action as maneuver.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.153

detail.name: Unity Assault
detail.description: If a missed combat check generates [TR] or [AD][AD][AD], may spend to perform Force power targeting allies as a maneuver.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.153

detail.name: Valuable Facts
detail.description: Once per encounter, perform a Valuable Facts action: make an [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Knowledge check[b]. If successful, add [TR] to one ally's skill check during the enounter.

detail.name: Bad Cop
detail.description: May spend [AD][AD] from a Deception or Coercion check to upgrade ability of a single ally's subsequent Social Interaction check against the target a number of times equal to ranks in Bad Cop.

detail.name: Biggest Fan
detail.description: Once per session, may take a Biggest Fan action; make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Charm check[b] to turn one NPC into the character's biggest fan.

detail.name: Congenial
detail.description: May suffer a number of strain to downgrade difficulty of Charm or Negotiation checks or upgrade difficulty when target by Charm or Negotiation checks, by an equal number Strain suffered this way cannot exceed ranks in Congenial.

detail.name: Coordination Dodge
detail.description: When targeted by a combat check, may spend 1 Destiny Point to add [FA] equal to ranks in Coordination to check.

detail.name: Distracting Behavior
detail.description: Make a Distracting Behavior maneuver and suffer strain no greater than ranks in Cunning. Until the beginning of next turn, equal number of NPC's suffer [TH] on checks. Range increases with additional ranks.

detail.name: Distracting Behavior (Improved)
detail.description: The Distracting Behavior maneuver inflicts [TH][TH] on NPC's checks when NPC's target character's allies.

detail.name: Deceptive Taunt
detail.description: Once per session, may make Deceptive Taunt action. Make opposed Deception check. If successful, one adversary must attack the character during adversary's next turn.

detail.name: Good Cop
detail.description: May spend [AD][AD] from a Charm or Negotiation check to upgrade ability of a single ally's subsequent Social Interaction check against the target a number of times equal to ranks in Good Cop.

detail.name: Natural Athlete
detail.description: Once per session, may reroll any 1 Athletics or Coordination check.

detail.name: Natural Merchant
detail.description: Once per session, may reroll any 1 Streetwise or Negotiation check.

detail.name: Throwing Credits
detail.description: At beginning of session, spend 100 credits to ignore strain threshold penalty due to triggered Obligation.

detail.name: Unrelenting Skeptic
detail.description: When targeted by a Deception check, the character automatically adds [FA] to the check equal to ranks in Vigilance.

detail.name: Unrelenting Skeptic (Improved)
detail.description: When targeted by a Deception check that fails, may spend 1 Destiny Point to add [DE] to results.

detail.name: Beast Wrangler
detail.description: Add [BO] per rank of Beast Wrangler to checks to tame or wrangle creatures.

detail.name: Bolstered Armor
detail.description: Increase the armor value of Signature Vehicle by 1 per rank of Bolstered Armor.

detail.name: Corellian Sendoff
detail.description: Take a Correllin Sendoff action targeting two ships or vehicles at Close range; make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Cool check[b] to cause the targets to suffer a minor collision.

detail.name: Corellian Sendoff (Improved)
detail.description: When performing a Corellian Sendoff, the targets suffer a major collision instead.

detail.name: Customized Cooling Unit
detail.description: Increase the system strain threshold of Signature Vehicle by 2 per rank of Customized Cooling Unit.

detail.name: Expert Handler
detail.description: Remove [SE] per rank of Expert Handler from Survival checks made to ride beasts.

detail.name: Fancy Paint Job
detail.description: Upgrade all Charm, Deception, and Negotiation checks made in the presence of Signature Vehicle once.

detail.name: Fortified Vacuum Seal
detail.description: Increase the hull trauma threshold of Signature Vehicle by 1 per rank of Fortified Vacuum Seal.

detail.name: High-G Training
detail.description: When a starship or vehicle being piloted would suffer system strain, may suffer strain up to ranks in High-G Training to prevent an equal amount of system strain.

detail.name: Koiogran Turn
detail.description: When an opponent has gained the advantage on a starship or vehicle being piloted, may perform a Koiogran Turn maneuver to remove the effects.

detail.name: Larger Project
detail.description: Signature Vehicle can have a silhouette 1 larger per rank of Larger Project.

detail.name: Not Today
detail.description: Once per session, spend a Destiny Point to save Signature Vehicle from destruction.

detail.name: Overstocked Ammo
detail.description: Increase the value of the Limited Ammo quality of any weapons mounted on Signature Vehicle by 1 per rank of Overstocked Ammo.

detail.name: Reinforced Frame
detail.description: Signature Vehicle gains Massive 1: when making an attack targeting the ship or vehicle, the Critical rating of any weapon used counts as 1 higher.

detail.name: Showboat
detail.description: When making a check in a starship or vehicle, may suffer 2 strain to gain [TR] on success or [DE] on failure.

detail.name: Signature Vehicle
detail.description: Choose one starship or vehicle as Signature Vehicle Upgrade all Mechanics checks made on that vehicle once.

detail.name: Soothing Tone
detail.description: Take a Soothing Tone action; make an [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Knowledge (Xenology) check[b] to allow a beast to recover strain equal to [SU].

detail.name: Spur
detail.description: Take a Spur action; make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Survival check[b] to increase a beast's top speed by 1. The beast suffers 2 strain every round it stays spurred.

detail.name: Spur (Improved)
detail.description: Suffer 1 strain to attempt Spur as a maneuver and decrease its difficult to [B]Average ([DI][DI]).[b]

detail.name: Spur (Supreme)
detail.description: When activating and maintaining Spur, the beast only suffers 1 strain instead of 2.

detail.name: Tuned Maneuvering Thrusters
detail.description: Increase the handling of Signature Vehicle by 1 per rank of Tuned Maneuvering Thrusters.

detail.name: Call 'Em
detail.description: Do not add [SE] to combat checks due to the use of the Aim maneuver.

detail.name: Disarming Smile
detail.description: Take the Disarming Smile action; succeed at an opposed Charm check to lower all defenses of a target by ranks in Disarming Smile until the end of the encounter.

detail.name: Don't Shoot!
detail.description: Once per session as an action, make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Charm check[b]. On a success, cannot be target of combat checks until the end of the encounter or until making a combat check.

detail.name: Double or Nothing
detail.description: Suffer 2 strain to perform the Double or Nothing incidental to increase the difficulty of the next check by one. Then, after canceling opposing symbols, double the amount of remaining [AD]

detail.name: Double or Nothing (Improved)
detail.description: When performing the Double or Nothing incidental, after canceling opposing symbols, also double the amount of remaining [SU].

detail.name: Double or Nothing (Supreme)
detail.description: When performing the Double or Nothing incidental, also double the number of [TR] amd [DE].

detail.name: Fortune Favors the Bold
detail.description: Once per session as an incidental, suffer 2 strain to flip one dark side Destiny Point to light side.

detail.name: Guns Blazing
detail.description: As an incidental, suffer 2 Strain to avoid increasing the difficulty of a Ranged (Light) check to attack with two weapons.

detail.name: Just Kidding!
detail.description: Once per round as an incidental spend 1 Destiny Point to ignore [DE] generated on a social check by the character or any ally in short range.

detail.name: Quick Draw (Improved)
detail.description: May use Quick Draw twice per round.

detail.name: Second Chances
detail.description: Once per encounter choose a number of positive dice equal to ranks in Second Changes and reroll them.

detail.name: Sorry About the Mess
detail.description: Decrease the Critical Rating of a weapon by 1 (to a minimum of 1) against targets that have not yet acted this encounter.

detail.name: Spitfire
detail.description: After a successful combined check with two Ranged (Light) weapons, additional hits can be allocated to other targets within range of the weapon.

detail.name: Up the Ante
detail.description: When gambling win 10% more credits per rank of Up the Ante.

detail.name: Bad Press
detail.description: Once per session, choose an organization and make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Deception check[b]. On success, organization members have their wound thresholds reduced by 1, plus 1 per [SU][SU][SU], until the end of the session.

detail.name: Blackmail
detail.description: When an NPC exceeds his strain threshold, may spend 1 Destiny Point to convince that NPC to perform a single task of choice instead.

detail.name: Cutting Question
detail.description: Once per encounter, when making a Coercion skill check, the character may use Deception skill instead.

detail.name: Discredit
detail.description: Once per encounter, take the Discredit action, make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Deception check[b] to upgrade the difficulty of one character's social checks once, plus once for every [AD][AD], until of the encounter.

detail.name: Encoded Communique
detail.description: Upgrade the difficulty of checks to decrypt this character's coded messages without the proper cipher a number of times equal to Computers skill.

detail.name: Encouraging Words
detail.description: After an engaged ally fails a check, may suffer 1 strain to assist that ally's next check this encounter as an out of turn incidental.

detail.name: In The Know
detail.description: Once per session while in an enemy facility or vessel, may perform the Inside Knowledge action, make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Skulduggery check[b]. Character may then find a single personal scale item with a rarity no greater than Cunning plus 2 previously stashed here, or gain a narrative benefit.

detail.name: In The Know (Improved)
detail.description: Once per session, make an [B]opposed Decepetion vs Vigilance[b] check with the difficulty downgraded once per rank of In the Know to have a target NPC believe specific false intelligence.

detail.name: Informant
detail.description: Once per session, may reveal a contact who can shed light on a chosen subject.

detail.name: Interjection
detail.description: After another character makes a social check, suffer 3 strain to take an interjection incidental make an [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Vigilance check[b] to add [SU] or [FA] equal to [SU], and [AD] or [TH] equal to [AD] to the check.

detail.name: Know-It-All
detail.description: Once per session, perfectly recall an important fact previously learned as if a Destiny Point had been spent.

detail.name: Plausible Deniability (Improved)
detail.description: Take an Improved Plausible Deniability action makes a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Coercion check[b] to convince one bystander per rank of Plausible Deniability to depart quietly.

detail.name: Positive Spin
detail.description: Whenever any character's Duty would increase, it increases by an additional 1 per rank of Positive Spin.

detail.name: Positive Spin (Improved)
detail.description: Once per session, if no PC's Duty triggered, make a [B]Daunting ([DI][DI][DI][DI]) Charm check[b] with the difficulty decreased once rank of Positive Spin to have one PC's Duty trigger.

detail.name: Researcher (Improved)
detail.description: On a successful Knowledge check, character and allies gain automatic [AD] per rank of Researcher on checks to act on those facts until the end of his next turn.

detail.name: Supporting Evidence
detail.description: When assisting an ally with a Charm, Deception, Leadership, or Negotiation check, add automatic [AD] per rank of Supporting Evidence.

detail.name: Thorough Assessment
detail.description: Once per session, take a Thorough Assessment action: make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Knowledge check[b] to gain Boost dice equal to [SU] that can be distributed during the encounter.

detail.name: Twisted Words
detail.description: When an incoming social check generates [TH][TH] or [DE], may suffer 1 strain as an incidental to inflict strain equal to ranks in Coercion on speaker.

detail.name: Drive Back
detail.description: The Inquisitor may spend [TR] or [AD][AD][AD] on a missed Brawl, Melee, or Lightsaber combat check to force target to make a move maneuver in a direction of the Inquisitor's choice.
detail.source: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook p.419
